question: Can access to actual prior execution feedback and an AI-authored judgment review improve the next real data-processing action beyond access to the same raw feedback alone?
domain: Engineered extraction work items over three unchanged, real, previously published Results JSON files. Declarative AI actions run against the actual files and write new machine-readable artifacts. This is not new natural conversation or an ecological brain task.
source_scope: Three full public files chosen for compact differing schemas, not held-out previously unseen sources. Transfer means new task objectives over the same available files; repeated positive tasks are same-run regression checks, not delayed or autonomous retention.
authoring: New source-only actual AI authors one supported (3-5 requested numeric fields) and one source-unavailable work item per source for practice, and separate new supported (3-5 numeric fields) and unavailable task per source for transfer. No paraphrase-only same-result transfer, no fake data, no false claims of observed real-world episodes. Each expected artifact and exact source-path calculation fixed by author and approved by independent new reviewer before any actor. Three repeated-practice items copy the positive practice objectives/expected artifacts exactly with neutral new IDs.

arms.prior_plan_only: All previous practice task texts and AI actions/predictions, no execution results, validation verdicts or review.
arms.raw_feedback: Same practice task texts/actions/predictions plus complete actual execution outputs/artifacts/validation feedback.
arms.raw_feedback_and_review: Identical raw_feedback bundle plus actual AI-authored post-outcome judgment-change/confirmation record.

comparisons: Primary raw_feedback_and_review vs raw_feedback isolates added review access, not feedback itself. Raw_feedback vs prior_plan_only diagnostic isolates explicit feedback access while prior actions are shared. All arms get the same current full sources, tasks, DSL, action opportunity and per-item cap. They can recompute earlier actions from current sources; no assertion of hidden information or equal input length/compute.
order: Approve and freeze task/gold, implementation and source hashes before actions.
One fresh fork-none AI context writes six practice actions and predictions without gold; freeze all before running.
Execute all six actions as actual artifact writes, keep success/failure without selecting or repairing semantic outputs.

One new fork-none AI writes bounded <=6000 canonical characters of observational memory with old judgment, actual outcome, new judgment/confirmation, why, uncertainty and future test, actual event IDs. No unsupported causal or learning claim.

Three fresh fork-none contexts receive counterbalanced-order matched nine later tasks in order: transfer/repeat interleaved. Dispatch raw_feedback, raw_feedback_and_review, prior_plan_only; no later outcomes available to any actor until all27 actions frozen.
Run all27 actions, no retry, repair, task replacement or memory updating on their outcomes. Independently audit counts and meaning/limits before results publication.
actions: Public deterministic DSL op=get(source alias,path array),sum(args),sub(left,right),div(left,right), or source-unavailable artifact. Actual AI selects operation/path/status and prediction/rationale. Code resolves paths, calculates, writes artifact and compares it with prelocked independent-AI expected artifact; it never authors task meanings, memories, predictions or semantic explanations.
outcomes: actual artifact correct by frozen expected typed values
execution failure and schema error separately
paired corrected/regressed for identical later tasks
prediction accepted/rejected/uncertain versus actual validator verdict
per-item canonical output character cost and cap violations
grade_boundary: Mechanical exact artifact validation is appropriate for this numerical data-processing contract, not semantic memory comprehension, autonomous meaningful judgment or psychological learning. Independent AI input review is required for task meaning and expected artifact. Final interpretation audited; no controller-authored meaning grades.
limits: Only three schema sources and six distinct new transfer tasks; descriptive bounded pilot, no significance/population rates.
No forced failures. If practice succeeds, error-correction learning is untested.
A memory record is an external input; different fresh AI contexts, no model parameter updates or continuous identity demonstrated.
No source retrieval selection, SHIORI graph/binary speed, complete LRE Wake, Emotion effect, native ChatGPT integration, biological brain/AGI/consciousness proof.
Context/task IDs orchestration only; modelidentity/settings/provider request counts and tokencompute unavailable:null.
All roles share host with instruction-limited file access, not OS isolation. Input lengths can differ; measured and reported.
Public existing data may have prior training exposure; task objective held-out from actors until packet delivery only.
collection: All authored first actions retained. Max one format-only collection repair if unreadable JSON prevents ingestion, retain original and disclose; no semantic retry, truncation or score-based exclusion. If authored query/gold rejected pre-execution, retain rejection and at most one source-author revision. Never execute actions before code engineering tests and task review approval.
protection: Read-only all13 earlier study roots and production3816 tracked files; no canonical memory, Emotion, Reflection, SELF_STATE, Wake changes. No private conversation source reads, no hosted workflow/billing changes.
publication: Append actual JA/EN results only after independent source/count/privacy audit. Engineered task instructions/expected/actions/results and public sources can be published for deterministic replay after audit. Replaying saved AI actions is not fresh AI regeneration. Preserve all old studies/data/animations/history. No private paths or user details in public artifacts.
